about: Headings that open a recipe's ingredients or its steps, for a page with no recipe data (#103). They only choose which part of the page's text goes to the on-device model. A line matches when it is short and starts with one of these, lowercased, as whole words. A nutrition heading and a nutrient line (a nutrients word, then only a number and maybe g, mg, kcal, kj, cal or %: "kcal507", "Fat: 10g") are left out of the window (#271): a nutrition box is not the recipe, and its short numeric lines read as ingredients.
